condition: Migraine with aura on the combined pill

patient_persona.description: Nur Syafiqah binti Azmi, 27, female, call centre team leader in Cyberjaya; on the combined oral contraceptive pill for two years. First visit. Lively, quick Klang Valley Malay with a lot of English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Jonathan Lau Kok Meng, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP in Cyberjaya. Friendly, careful; English-leaning, comfortable in Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya selalu sakit kepala sebelah, berdenyut-denyut. Tapi yang buat saya takut, sebelum sakit tu mata nampak lampu zig-zag.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lampu zig-zag tu berapa lama, and then the headache comes after?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dalam dua puluh minit, then hilang, lepas tu kepala mula sakit. Kadang-kadang vomit, and I can't stand bright light.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pernah ada tangan kebas sebelah, atau susah nak bercakap masa tu? Like slurred speech?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Once, jari kiri kebas sikit. Lepas tu OK balik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This sounds like migraine with aura. Aura tu gangguan sementara dalam otak, biasanya harmless by itself.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tapi saya nampak dalam rekod, you makan pil perancang, the combined one. Betul?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, dah dua tahun. Kenapa, doktor? Ada problem ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For women with migraine with aura, pil kombinasi ni naikkan risiko stroke. So kita kena stop dan tukar method.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Strok? Saya baru dua puluh tujuh! Habis, nak guna apa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risikonya masih kecil, tapi tak perlu ambil risiko. Options: progestogen-only pill, implant, or IUD. Semua tu selamat untuk migraine.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, saya discuss dengan suami. Untuk sakit kepala, boleh makan apa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Waktu mula sakit, naproxen 500mg, and metoclopramide 10mg kalau loya. If still not enough, next visit we can try sumatriptan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kerja saya depan skrin lapan jam, headset pun bising.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Try rehat mata setiap jam, minum air cukup, tidur ikut masa. Buat headache diary, catat hari dan pencetus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Pil tu saya stop terus hari ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop lepas habis pek ni, tapi guna kondom sampai method baru start. Datang balik dua minggu.

patient_persona.description: Khor Siew Lin, 42, female, insurance agent in Georgetown, Penang; menstrual migraine; mild asthma. Follow-up after three months of flunarizine. Chatty, animated Penang Mandarin with Hokkien and English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ng Boon Keat, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, neurologist at a Penang hospital. Measured, thorough; English-leaning, speaks Mandarin with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 许小姐，flunarizine 吃了三个月，头痛有减少吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有啦，以前一个月十天，现在大概五六天。可是我胖了五公斤，dress 都穿不下！

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个是 flunarizine 常见的 side effect，会让人胃口好。心情怎样？有没有比较 down？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 心情还好，就是看到体重很 down。可以换别的吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以。本来 propranolol 是很好的选择，但是你有 asthma，propranolol 会让你喘，所以不适合。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 对，我还有带 Ventolin。那还有什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以用 amitriptyline 10mg，晚上吃。也 help sleep，但是 morning 可能有点 drowsy，嘴巴干。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我的头痛都是月经前两天开始，这个有什么办法？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有。你的 period 很准时，所以我们可以用 mini-prophylaxis：period 前两天开始吃 naproxen 500mg，一天两次，吃五天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 attack 的时候，sumatriptan 还可以用吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，50mg，头痛一开始就吃。两个钟头没好 boleh 再吃一次，一天 maximum 两次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。那 flunarizine 马上停吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以停，不用慢慢减。Amitriptyline 从今晚开始，两个礼拜后如果没什么 side effect，可以加到 20mg。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 体重会不会也 naik？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有一些人会，但是比较少。多 exercise，也有助减少头痛。三个月后带 headache diary 回来。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Arul a/l Subramaniam, 44, male, engineer in Klang, speaking for his 11-year-old daughter Kavya, who has recurrent headaches. First visit. Calm, detail-oriented Malaysian Indian English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siti Zubaidah binti Omar, Malay woman in her 40s, paediatrician at a Klang hospital. Warm with children, direct with parents; English-leaning, some Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, Kavya has been getting headaches almost every week for three months. Kadang-kadang muntah, and she has to come home from school.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kavya, can you show me where it hurts? Both sides of the forehead? And does it throb, like a heartbeat?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: She says yes, berdenyut, and she wants to lie in a dark room. After she sleeps, she's fine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any headaches that wake her from sleep, or vomiting first thing in the morning?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, never at night. Usually afternoon, especially after tuition.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Does she skip breakfast or lunch? How much screen time?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Honestly, breakfast she doesn't eat, rushing to sekolah. And tablet games at night, maybe two hours.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any family history of migraine?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My wife, and her mother also. Teruk punya migraine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Her neurological exam, eye check and blood pressure are all normal. This looks like childhood migraine, which often runs in families.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So no need for a brain scan? My wife quite risau.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: With a normal exam and no warning signs, a scan won't help. If anything changes, we'll scan straight away.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When a headache starts, give ibuprofen 300mg straight away with water, then rehat in a quiet room. Can alternate with paracetamol.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Should she avoid anything? Chocolate, maybe? Dia suka sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Regular meals are more important, jangan skip sarapan. Tidur cukup, kurang screen time waktu malam, minum air banyak. Keep a simple headache diary.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, we'll try. Bila kami patut datang balik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: In two months with the diary. Come earlier if she has weakness, confusion, or a very sudden severe headache.

patient_persona.description: Mohd Amran bin Juhin, 35, male, Bajau fisherman's son now working as a hotel maintenance technician in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; three days of migraine. Emergency department. Low, exhausted voice, Sabah Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Stephanie Chong Mei Fong, Sabahan Chinese woman in her 30s, emergency physician in Kota Kinabalu. Efficient, empathetic; English-leaning, speaks Sabah Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Amran, saya Dr. Stephanie, emergency doctor. Sakit kepala ni dah tiga hari tak berhenti?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga hari, doktor. Kepala kanan macam dipukul. Muntah sudah banyak kali, makan pun tak masuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pernah sakit kepala macam ni sebelum ni? Any history?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pernah, migraine sejak muda. Tapi selalu one day sudah hilang. This time lain, too long already.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sakit tu datang tiba-tiba macam kena tembak, atau perlahan-lahan naik?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Perlahan-lahan, macam biasa. Cuma tak hilang-hilang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada demam, leher keras, lemah tangan kaki, atau double vision?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada semua tu. Cuma sensitif cahaya, mata pedih bila lampu terang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your neuro exam is normal, tiada demam, leher tak keras. This is status migrainosus, migraine yang lebih dari 72 jam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita pasang drip dulu sebab you dehydrated. Saya bagi metoclopramide 10mg dalam drip, dengan ketorolac untuk sakit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat Panadol sudah makan banyak, tak jalan bah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Berapa banyak dalam tiga hari? How many tablets?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dua biji, empat kali sehari. Lepas tu tambah lagi dua malam tadi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu dah lebih 4 gram sehari, bahaya untuk hati. Kita check liver function sekali. Selepas ni, jangan lebih lapan biji sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Sorry, saya tak tahu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa. Kalau sakit reda, boleh balik petang ni. Follow-up klinik untuk ubat pencegahan, sebab dah kerap sangat.

condition: Migraine refill with coronary artery disease

patient_persona.description: Choo Kah Meng, 57, male, owns a hardware and paint shop in Ipoh; long-standing migraine on sumatriptan; had a coronary stent six months ago in KL, and his usual GP did not know. Refill visit. Brusque, fast Malaysian Mandarin with Cantonese colouring.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chandran a/l Muthu, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, GP in Ipoh for twenty years. Unflappable, friendly; English-leaning, speaks conversational Mandarin and Cantonese words.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，老样子，我要拿 sumatriptan，两盒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay, Mr. Choo. Before that, any new medicine since last visit? 我看你的 file 很久没更新了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦，有啦。六个月前我在 KL 做了 stent，心脏的血管塞了。现在吃 aspirin 和 clopidogrel，还有 statin。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ah, that's very important. Sumatriptan 会让血管收缩，including the heart ones. 放了 stent 以后，we cannot use it anymore.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我头痛怎么办？这个药最有效。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I understand. Attack 的时候，naproxen is also risky with your aspirin and clopidogrel, 胃会出血。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那 Panadol 呢？我以前觉得没什么用。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 1 gram 加 metoclopramide 10mg 一起吃, works better than paracetamol alone. 头痛一开始就吃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How often are the attacks now? 比去年多还是少？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 比较多，一个月七八次。自从心脏的事以后，睡不好，很 worry。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: With that frequency, 需要 preventive。Candesartan 8mg is a good choice. 它是 BP 的药，对心脏也 safe。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我血压不高喔，吃了会不会 pening？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We start low, 两个礼拜后 check 你的 BP。If you feel dizzy standing up, 告诉我。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦。那 cardiologist 那边要讲吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, 我会写 letter 给你在 KL 的 cardiologist。Next time, bring all your medicine boxes.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK，谢谢 doctor，还好你有问。

condition: Chronic tension-type headache with medication overuse

patient_persona.description: Janice Ho Mei Yee, 38, female, senior tax accountant in Kuala Lumpur, near-daily headaches through tax season; takes Panadol Extra most days. First visit. Fast, clipped Malaysian Chinese English with some Cantonese.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Farhana binti Abdul Razak, Malay woman in her 30s, family medicine specialist in Kuala Lumpur. Warm, practical; English-leaning, some Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, I've had headaches almost every day for five months. Both sides, like a tight band around my head. By evening, 好辛苦.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Is it throbbing, or pressing? Any vomiting, or sensitivity to light?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pressing, not throbbing. No vomiting. I can still work, just very tak selesa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: What have you been taking for it?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Panadol Extra. Two in the morning, two lepas lunch, sometimes two at night. Almost every day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Panadol Extra has caffeine too. Taking painkillers more than fifteen days a month can itself cause daily headaches. We call it medication overuse headache.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So the medicine is making it worse? Oh no.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Partly, yes. The other part is tension type headache. How's your sleep, and your work hours?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tax season, doctor. Office until eleven, then emails in bed. Leher and bahu always stiff.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your shoulders are very tight when I press. How's your mood? Feeling down or anxious lately?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Stressed, yes. Not depressed, I think. Just penat all the time.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Plan: stop Panadol Extra. The first one to two weeks might be worse, but it will improve. Start amitriptyline 10mg at night as a preventive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Amitriptyline, isn't that an antidepressant? Ubat for depression?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At this low dose, it's used for headache and sleep, not depression. It may cause some morning grogginess and dry mouth.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. What else can I do?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Neck stretches every hour, laptop at eye level, and stop checking emails in bed. See you in six weeks with a headache diary.

condition: Tension-type headache, worried about a brain tumour

patient_persona.description: Kamarul Ariffin bin Saleh, 45, male, logistics supervisor at a port in Pasir Gudang, Johor; his cousin recently died of a brain tumour. First visit. Anxious, fast Johor Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wong Pui San, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, GP in Pasir Gudang. Calm, validating; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya nak buat CT scan kepala. Dah sebulan sakit kepala, saya takut ada ketumbuhan. Sepupu saya baru meninggal sebab tumor otak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Takziah, encik. Tentu encik risau sangat. Boleh cerita macam mana sakit kepala tu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Macam kepala kena ikat, dua-dua belah. Petang lagi teruk, lepas balik kerja, especially bila jem.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada muntah, sakit sampai terjaga malam, atau lemah tangan kaki? Any weakness?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada muntah. Tidur pun... sebenarnya saya susah nak tidur, fikir pasal sepupu saya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Penglihatan kabur, blurred vision, atau sawan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada. Mata OK je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya dah check mata, saraf, kekuatan, refleks. Semua normal. Tekanan darah 128 over 80, pun normal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sakit kepala encik ni macam tension type headache. Selalunya berkait dengan stress, kurang tidur dan otot leher tegang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tapi doktor, macam mana nak confirm bukan tumor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tumor otak biasanya ada tanda lain, macam weakness, morning vomiting, atau perubahan kelakuan. Encik tak ada semua ni. CT scan tak perlu sekarang, radiation pun ada.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya masih takut juga, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham. Macam ni, kalau dalam empat minggu tak berkurang, atau ada tanda yang saya sebut, kita buat scan terus. Setuju?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, setuju. Ubat apa saya boleh makan? Ubat tahan sakit biasa boleh?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 1 gram bila perlu, not more than ten days a month. Dan cuba bercakap dengan kaunselor tentang kehilangan sepupu, kita ada di klinik ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Lega sikit rasa hati.

condition: Tension-type headache in a university student

patient_persona.description: Lim Jia En, 19, female, first-year accounting student at a private university in Kampar, Perak, living in a hostel; drinks two bubble teas and coffee daily. First visit. Soft, hesitant Malaysian Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Faiz bin Ramli, Malay man in his 30s, doctor at the university health clinic. Friendly, big-brother manner; English-leaning, speaks basic Mandarin phrases with students.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Jia En. Headache 多久了？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 差不多三个礼拜，从 midterm 开始。整个头都紧紧的，好像戴了一顶很紧的帽子。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Every day? Morning 还是 evening 比较严重？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 几乎每天，晚上比较严重。我 study 到三点。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How much coffee or bubble tea a day? 一天几杯？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 早上一杯 coffee，下午两杯 bubble tea……有时候晚上再一杯 Nescafé。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a lot of caffeine. 你太晚喝，sleep becomes bad，第二天就头痛。It's a cycle, 一直重复。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是不喝的话，我温书会想睡觉，assignment 做不完。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I know. Cut down slowly, not suddenly, 不然 caffeine withdrawal 也会头痛。One less drink every few days.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Are you eating properly? Any vomiting or blurred vision?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有呕吐。吃饭……有时候只吃一餐，因为很赶上课。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Skipping meals also triggers headaches. 你的 exam 是 normal，so this is tension type headache, not something dangerous.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我可以吃 Panadol 吗？我室友给我吃了几次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can, paracetamol 1 gram when needed, but not more than two or three days a week. Otherwise it causes rebound headache.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的。我是不是 stress 太大？我家人期望很高。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That may be part of it. 学校的 counselling centre 是免费的。Want me to book you an appointment? No pressure.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 嗯……好，试一试。谢谢医生。

patient_persona.description: Joseph a/l Arokiasamy, 52, male, senior clerk at a bus company depot in Sentul, Kuala Lumpur; wife recently had surgery. Follow-up after two months of amitriptyline. Warm, slow Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Soo Min, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist in Sentul. Attentive, gentle; English-leaning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Joseph, how are the headaches after two months of amitriptyline?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Much better, doctor. Last time almost every day, now maybe once or twice a week. Tak teruk macam dulu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's good progress. Any side effects? Dry mouth, constipation, feeling sleepy in the morning?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mouth a bit dry, I minum more water. Morning a bit blur for the first two weeks, now okay already.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How's your sleep now?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sleep better also. Before this I keep waking up, thinking about my wife.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How is your wife recovering from her operation?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Slowly, doctor. Hip replacement. I help her with everything, mandi, masak. Sometimes I feel very tired, very down.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a lot to carry. Have you had times recently where you felt hopeless, or that life is not worth living?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, no, not like that. Just penat. My children datang on weekends to help.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm glad you have them. If those feelings ever get heavier, please tell me. There's also a caregiver support group at the hospital.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. Maybe my daughter can tolong find out about it.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let's continue amitriptyline 10mg at night for another four months, then we'll try slowly stopping.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I take Panadol kalau sakit kepala datang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, paracetamol 1 gram, but keep it under ten days a month. Keep doing the neck exercises, and remember to rest too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I will. Terima kasih, doctor.

condition: New headache in an older adult, suspected giant cell arteritis

patient_persona.description: Soh Ah Kow, 72, male, retired lorry driver in Melaka; three weeks of new headache, scalp tenderness, jaw pain while chewing, feels feverish; thought it was stress headache. First visit. Gruff, slow Malaysian Mandarin with Hokkien.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Ain binti Hashim, Malay woman in her 30s, GP in Melaka. Sharp, careful; English-leaning, speaks simple Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我头痛三个礼拜了。我儿子说是压力大，tension headache，叫我吃 Panadol 就好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle 以前常常头痛吗？还是最近才 start？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 以前很少。这次是新的，右边太阳穴这里，sikat 头发的时候皮都会痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 吃东西的时候，下巴会不会累，或者痛？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 会！吃 ayam 咬一咬，下巴就酸，要停下来 rest。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 眼睛有没有看东西模糊，或者突然一边看不到？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 前天早上，右眼好像有一片黑黑的，几分钟就 OK 了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle，这个很重要。我摸一下太阳穴……这里的血管很硬，而且痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你七十多岁，新的头痛，头皮痛，吃东西下巴痛，眼睛也有问题。我担心是 giant cell arteritis，血管发炎。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 血管发炎？严不严重？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果不治疗，可能会突然 blind。所以今天就要验血，ESR 和 CRP，then start prednisolone immediately。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 今天就吃 steroid？不用等报告？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，不能等。Prednisolone 60mg 今天开始。我也会写信，叫你明天去医院的 rheumatology 和眼科。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，好。我叫我儿子 drive 我去。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果眼睛再黑，或者看不到，马上去 emergency，不要等明天。
